notes.text: Placings (1 to 8, as magic.gg numbers them) and archetype names are from magic.gg's Tolarian Academy Championship results table; mtgo.com names no archetypes.
Started 2020-10-24 00:05 PDT; nine Swiss rounds, Top 8 the same day.
Magic Online lists each printing of a card on its own line; copies of the same card are added together here.
Seeds are the seeding shown in mtgo.com's Top 8 bracket.
